name: Industrial Plant Inspection under EMCON
mission_theme: Refinery turnaround: close inspection of towers and pipe racks under radio silence and a strict no-fly envelope.

zones.notes: hot work below, no hover over 60 s

task_generation.rule: tasks are instantiated from the 10 task templates with scenario-specific parameters; composite tasks add contingency patterns that combine two templates

tasks.title: Point inspection of POI-DISTILLATION-TOWER (15 m standoff, 6 images)
tasks.brief: Inspect POI-DISTILLATION-TOWER. Hold a standoff of 15 m (tolerance 3 m) at 60 m AGL, aim the gimbal 0 deg down and take at least 6 images per face. Hover at least 12 s at each capture point so the image is stable. Do not enter the 15 m keep-out radius around POI-DISTILLATION-TOWER and keep 25 m from your teammate.
tasks.objective: Inspect POI-DISTILLATION-TOWER from 15 m standoff at 60 m AGL, capture at least 6 images per viewing angle with the gimbal pitched 0 deg down, and hold each capture position for 12 s.

actions: move to the 15 m standoff ring
capture 6 images per angle with 0 deg pitch
check image count and pitch per angle
re-capture any angle short of 6 images

constraints: hover only at declared capture points
no flight below 60 m in the inspection ring
failure_conditions: entering the 15 m keep-out radius
fewer than one complete angle set at task end
loss of link during capture with no recovery

tasks.title: Coverage survey of BLOCK-TANK-FARM (90% target, 2 UAVs)
tasks.brief: Your team must survey the block BLOCK-TANK-FARM completely. Fly parallel tracks at 60 m AGL with 25 % side overlap and keep every UAV 15 m apart. The survey is accepted only when the reported coverage of the block is at least 90 %. Recover to LZ-GATE-1 when the coverage target is met or the task window closes.
tasks.objective: Fly a complete parallel-track survey of BLOCK-TANK-FARM with 2 UAVs at 60 m AGL and deliver a coverage record that reaches at least 90 % of the block with 25 % side overlap between adjacent tracks.

actions: assign one strip set per UAV
mission_phases.output: track plan with strip ids and entry points

actions: form a safe line before entering the block
re-fly any strip that reports a gap
declare complete or request a re-fly

constraints: minimum separation 15 m at all times
single sortie per UAV for this task
no manual pilot override
failure_conditions: any UAV leaves the geofence
any UAV enters a no-fly zone
coverage below 60% when the task window closes
loss-of-control or collision flag

checkpoints.metric: cross-track error per strip and side overlap between adjacent strips

checkpoints.metric: time outside geofence and inside no-fly zones
checkpoints.target: 0 s outside geofence, 0 s inside any no-fly zone

checkpoints.name: Recovery
checkpoints.target: all UAVs on ground at LZ-GATE-1, separation >= 10 m, no hard landing

tasks.title: Grid sampling of GRID-LEAK (9 points, revisit every 8 min)
tasks.brief: Sample the 9 points of the GRID-LEAK grid with the gas sensor. Every point needs at least 3 samples, taken 8 +/- 2 min apart, and each sample must be geotagged within 5 m. Plan the order so that the revisit interval is respected without waiting on the ground.

tasks.brief: Fly from WP-ENTRY-W to WP-EXIT-E through CORRIDOR-PIPE in a column formation with 15 m spacing. tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Quality audit of the earlier BLOCK-UTILITIES survey
tasks.brief: BLOCK-UTILITIES was already surveyed once. As the audit team, re-fly 25 % of the block with a 50 m track spacing at 50 m, compare with the stored survey, and report every gap wider than 15 m. If the audit shows the claim is wrong, state the corrected coverage number and what has to be re-flown.
tasks.objective: Re-fly 25 % of BLOCK-UTILITIES and compare it with the earlier survey to decide whether the block meets the 85 % coverage claim, reporting any gap wider than 15 m.

actions: fly the audit tracks at 50 m
overlay the audit on the stored survey

constraints: audit tracks must not simply repeat the original track headings
no re-fly of the whole block
failure_conditions: audit plan identical to the original tracks
verdict without a corrected coverage number

checkpoints.name: Audit sample
checkpoints.metric: fraction of the block actually re-flown

checkpoints.name: Verdict accuracy
checkpoints.metric: corrected coverage statement versus ground truth
